description.en: Zero-shot Chinese/English voice cloning. A static ONNX runtime, smallest download and fastest on CPU — a good default engine.
description.zh: 中英文零样本克隆。ONNX 静态运行时，体积最小、CPU 速度最快，适合作为默认引擎。

note.en: Cloning requires the transcript of the reference audio.
note.zh: 克隆时必须提供参考音频对应的文字。

description.en: A lightweight 82M-parameter TTS that runs in real time on CPU. 54 official preset voices across 8 languages (English, Chinese, Japanese, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi). No voice cloning — choose a built-in voice. The installer adds the fp32 export on machines that run it faster (a CUDA build or an x86 CPU without AVX2), and the engine picks the better file automatically.
description.zh: 仅 82M 参数的轻量 TTS，CPU 上即可实时合成；54 个官方预置音色，覆盖中英日法西意葡印地 8 种语言。不支持声音克隆，只能选择内置音色。在 fp32 更快的机器上（CUDA 构建，或没有 AVX2 的 x86 CPU），安装时还会下载 fp32 导出，引擎会自动选用更快的那个文件。

note.en: Pure ONNX runtime — no Python or build toolchain needed. Preset voices only: when selected, the synth page hides the voice library/recorder/transcript and offers a built-in voice picker. The INT8 and fp32 files can coexist; deleting the fp32 one falls back to INT8.
note.zh: 纯 ONNX 运行时，无需 Python 或编译工具链。该模型只有预置音色：选中后合成页不会出现声音库/录音/参考文字，改为在引擎参数里选择音色。INT8 与 fp32 两个文件可以共存；删掉 fp32 文件即回退到 INT8。

description.en: On-device speech recognition for automatic reference-clip transcription. Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean/Cantonese with automatic number and punctuation normalization; fills the reference transcript with one tap after recording.
description.zh: 本地语音识别（参考音频自动转写）。中英日韩粤，数字与标点自动归一化；录音后可一键填入参考文字，无需手敲。

note.en: Optional: only useful when cloning engines (ZipVoice, LongCat, zero-shot CosyVoice) need a reference transcript; preset-voice engines like Kokoro do not use it. Pure ONNX, no Python needed.
note.zh: 可选组件：仅克隆类引擎（ZipVoice、LongCat、CosyVoice 零样本等）需要参考文字时有用；Kokoro 等预置音色引擎用不到。纯 ONNX，无需 Python。

description.en: 30 languages with zero-shot cloning and voice design. GGUF weights run locally through llama.cpp.
description.zh: 30 种语言、零样本克隆与声音设计。GGUF 权重经 llama.cpp 在本机推理。

note.en: Runs on the audio.cpp native runtime (CUDA on Windows with an NVIDIA GPU), shared with dots.tts and CosyVoice3 so it downloads once; the ~3 GB GGUF weights are fetched separately. A voice reference longer than 14 s is trimmed from the start at a silence point; 3-10 s of clean speech works best.
note.zh: 通过 audio.cpp 原生运行时推理（Windows 带 NVIDIA 显卡时使用 CUDA），与 dots.tts、CosyVoice3 共享同一个运行时，只下载一次；另需下载约 3 GB GGUF 权重。参考音频超过 14 秒时会自动截取开头并在静音点切分，建议直接使用 3–10 秒的干净人声。

description.en: Meituan's LongCat waveform-latent diffusion TTS, with zero-shot cloning close to Seed-TTS. The official audiodit package runs in an isolated venv.
description.zh: 美团 LongCat 的波形潜空间扩散 TTS，零样本克隆效果接近 Seed-TTS；官方 audiodit 包跑在独立 venv 中。

note.en: Requires Python 3.10–3.12 and Git. Cloning needs the reference transcript; clips much longer than the transcript are trimmed automatically. Numbers are read in Chinese and long text is split into chunks. Each run is capped at ~30 s including the reference. Set LONGCAT_MODEL=meituan-longcat/LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B for the larger ~15 GB model.
note.zh: 需要 Python 3.10–3.12 与 Git；克隆需要参考音频对应的文字，音频明显长于文字稿时会自动裁剪；数字会转成中文读法，长文本自动分段合成。单次最长约 30 秒（含参考音频）。可用 LONGCAT_MODEL=meituan-longcat/LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B 安装更大的版本（~15 GB）。

description.en: A 2B continuous-AR model with a 48 kHz AudioVAE, SOTA-level cloning on Seed-TTS. Runs on audio.cpp's native Metal/CUDA runtime — no Python needed.
description.zh: 2B 连续 AR + 48kHz AudioVAE，Seed-TTS 上 SOTA 级克隆；通过 audio.cpp 原生 Metal/CUDA 运行时推理，无需 Python。

note.en: Downloads the audio.cpp runtime and a 3 GB GGUF. Clones from the voice alone by default (robust even with an inaccurate transcript), with an optional voice+text mode; long text is split automatically. Metal on macOS, CPU elsewhere. Measured RTF ~1.3–1.9 on an M4 Pro.
note.zh: 下载 audio.cpp 运行时与 3GB GGUF；默认仅凭声音克隆（文字稿不准确也稳），也可选声纹+文字；长文本自动分段。macOS 走 Metal，其它平台走 CPU。M4 Pro 实测 RTF 约 1.3–1.9。

description.en: FunAudioLLM's 0.5B streaming LLM TTS with zero-shot cloning, cross-lingual synthesis and voice instructions. 9 languages plus Cantonese, on audio.cpp's native Metal runtime.
description.zh: FunAudioLLM 的 0.5B 流式 LLM TTS，零样本克隆、跨语种与指令控制；9 种语言 + 粤语，经 audio.cpp 原生 Metal 运行时推理。

note.en: Shares the audio.cpp runtime with dots.tts (downloaded once). Three templates: zero-shot (needs a transcript), cross-lingual (voice only) and instruct (describe the tone in words). Long text is split into chunks automatically so long inputs do not drop or repeat words.
note.zh: 与 dots.tts 共用 audio.cpp 运行时（只下载一次）。三种模板：零样本（需文字稿）、跨语种（只凭声音）、指令（用文字描述语气）。长文本会自动分段合成，避免长输入时漏字或重复。

description.en: The official qwen-tts package in an isolated Python venv. 10 languages, cloning from the voice alone.
description.zh: 官方 qwen-tts 包，跑在独立的 Python venv 中；10 种语言，仅凭声音即可克隆。

note.en: Requires Python 3.10–3.12; the script creates the isolated environment automatically. Uses MPS automatically on Apple Silicon.
note.zh: 需要 Python 3.10–3.12；脚本会自动创建隔离环境。Apple Silicon 上自动使用 MPS。

description.en: Qwen3-TTS preset speakers: nine built-in voices (Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean) with no reference clip needed, plus natural-language tone instructions.
description.zh: Qwen3-TTS 预置音色：9 个内置说话人（中英日韩），无需参考音频，并可用自然语言指令调整语气。

note.en: Shares one Python environment with the clone variant; reinstalling only downloads weights. Requires Python 3.10–3.12.
note.zh: 与克隆版共用同一个 Python 环境，重复安装只下载模型权重。需要 Python 3.10–3.12。

description.en: Create a voice from a natural-language description (voice design), e.g. "a gentle young woman speaking slightly slowly". No reference clip needed.
description.zh: 用自然语言描述来创造音色（声音设计），例如「一位温柔的年轻女性，语速稍慢」。无需参考音频。

note.en: The 1.7B model; a voice description is required to synthesize. Requires Python 3.10–3.12.
note.zh: 1.7B 模型，合成时必须填写音色描述。需要 Python 3.10–3.12。

description.en: Ming-3.0-tts ranks #1 among open-weights models on the Artificial Analysis Controlled Voice leaderboard. Clones a reference clip (Chinese/English and more) with a single 0.5B dense checkpoint; a transcript of the clip improves fidelity but is optional.
description.zh: Ming-3.0-tts 在 Artificial Analysis「受控音色克隆」排行榜中位列开源模型第一。用单个 0.5B 稠密模型克隆参考音频（中英及更多语言）；给出参考音频的文字可提升一致度，但非必需。

note.en: FST text normalization needs pynini (conda-forge only) and is skipped automatically when absent. Variants share one checkpoint/venv. Requires Python 3.10–3.12.
note.zh: FST 文本正则需要 pynini（仅 conda 提供），缺失时自动跳过。各变体共用同一份权重/venv。需要 Python 3.10–3.12。

description.en: Create a voice from a natural-language description (voice design), e.g. "a warm, calm male narrator". No reference clip needed. Shares the weights/venv with the clone variant.
description.zh: 用自然语言描述来创造音色（声音设计），例如「一位温暖沉稳的男声旁白」。无需参考音频。与克隆版共用权重/venv。

note.en: A voice description is required to synthesize. Requires the clone variant's weights/venv (installing it alone also fetches them). Requires Python 3.10–3.12.
note.zh: 合成时必须填写音色描述。需要克隆版的权重/venv（单独安装也会拉取）。需要 Python 3.10–3.12。

description.en: Clone a reference voice but speak German, Spanish, French, Korean or Japanese, plus Chinese/English. Shares the weights/venv with the clone variant.
description.zh: 克隆参考声音但说德语、西班牙语、法语、韩语或日语，以及中英文。与克隆版共用权重/venv。

note.en: The reference clip should be spoken in the target language for best results. Requires the clone variant's weights/venv (installing it alone also fetches them).
note.zh: 参考音频最好用目标语言录制以获得最佳效果。需要克隆版的权重/venv（单独安装也会拉取）。

description.en: Built-in Ming voices (UK/US English, Mandarin) with no reference clip needed. Shares the weights/venv with the clone variant.
description.zh: Ming 内置音色（英/美英语、中文普通话），无需参考音频。与克隆版共用权重/venv。

note.en: Preset voices only; no reference clip needed. Requires the clone variant's weights/venv (installing it alone also fetches them).
note.zh: 仅预置音色，无需参考音频。需要克隆版的权重/venv（单独安装也会拉取）。

description.en: Chatterbox (Resemble AI) is a 0.5B multilingual voice-clone model. Clone a reference clip and speak any of 23 languages — Chinese/English and more — in one model. Requires a Python 3.10–3.12 venv with the chatterbox-tts package (the released PyPI build, whose from_local() loads the v2 multilingual checkpoint).
description.zh: Chatterbox（Resemble AI）是 0.5B 多语言声音克隆模型。克隆一段参考音频即可说 23 种语言——中英文等——统一模型完成。需要装 chatterbox-tts 包的 Python 3.10–3.12 venv。

note.en: Clones a reference clip; a transcript of the clip is not required. Defaults to Chinese; pick a target language in the engine settings.
note.zh: 克隆参考音频即可，无需参考音频的文字稿。默认中文；可在引擎设置中选择目标语言。

description.en: IndexTTS-2 (bilibili) is a zero-shot voice-clone TTS for Chinese and English, pairing a GPT-style token model with a flow-matching vocoder. A reference clip of 15 s or less is enough; timbre similarity and prosody are strong. It runs on the shared audio.cpp native runtime with a Q8_0 GGUF, so no Python environment is needed.
description.zh: IndexTTS-2（bilibili）是面向中英文的零样本声音克隆模型，由 GPT 式 token 模型与流匹配声码器组成。15 秒以内的参考音频即可克隆，音色相似度和韵律表现都不错。通过共享的 audio.cpp 原生运行时加载 Q8_0 GGUF，无需 Python 环境。

note.en: No Python: the installer downloads the prebuilt audio.cpp runtime and a Q8_0 GGUF, shared with the dots.tts, CosyVoice and VoxCPM2 engines. The transcript of the reference clip is not used; the text language is auto-detected or set in the engine parameters.
note.zh: 无需 Python：安装脚本下载预编译的 audio.cpp 运行时与 Q8_0 GGUF，与 dots.tts、CosyVoice、VoxCPM2 共用。不使用参考音频的文字稿；文本语言自动判断，也可在引擎参数中选择。

description.en: MOSS-TTS-Delay (OpenMOSS) is a multilingual zero-shot TTS and voice-clone model driven by a native llama.cpp binary — no Python at inference time. The installer downloads that runtime prebuilt (macOS arm64/x64, Linux x64, Windows x64) and converts the audio tokenizer to GGUF once.
description.zh: MOSS-TTS-Delay（OpenMOSS）是多语言零样本 TTS / 声音克隆模型，由原生 llama.cpp 二进制作推理，运行时无需 Python。安装脚本下载预编译运行时（macOS arm64/x64、Linux x64、Windows x64），并一次性把音频 tokenizer 转成 GGUF。

note.en: The runtime is downloaded prebuilt, so no C++ toolchain is needed; only the one-time tokenizer conversion uses Python 3. Voice cloning is optional. Weights come from ModelScope, so no Hugging Face login is needed. Not offered on Windows: the prebuilt Windows runtime has no GPU backend and crashes intermittently with heap corruption (roughly one run in three, measured); macOS runs it on Metal, Linux on the CPU.
note.zh: 运行时直接下载预编译版本，不需要 C++ 工具链；只有一次性转换分词器需要 Python 3。克隆参考音频可选。权重来自 ModelScope，无需登录 Hugging Face。Windows 上不提供安装：预编译的 Windows 运行时没有 GPU 后端，并会间歇性堆损坏崩溃（实测约每三次运行一次）；macOS 使用 Metal，Linux 使用 CPU。
